title: Microsoft Restores Global Services After Major Outage
excerpt: Microsoft announces that Outlook, Teams, and Copilot are fully operational following a widespread, day-long service disruption.
body_html:
Microsoft has confirmed that its services are completely restored following a global outage that lasted an entire day. The technical disruption affected several key platforms, including Outlook, Teams, and Copilot.

According to the technology company, mitigation efforts to resolve the core issue causing the disruption have now finished. Users experienced widespread connectivity and access problems across the affected platforms while the issue persisted.

The company stated that the underlying problems have been successfully addressed, bringing all impacted services back to normal operation globally.
